hadith:
Accepting Information Given by a Truthful Person - Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The (call for prayer) Adhan of Bilal should not stop anyone of you from taking his Suhur for he pronounces the Adhan in order that whoever among you is praying the night prayer, may return (to eat his Suhur) and whoever among you is sleeping, may get up, for it is not yet dawn (when it is like this)." (Yahya, the sub-narrator stretched his two index fingers side ways).
message: Embrace patience as exemplified by Allah, who endures despite our shortcomings. Just as Prophet Noah warned his people with clarity and conviction, we too must convey truth with sincerity. Remember, even when faced with adversity, maintaining faith and perseverance can lead us through trials.
name:
As Saboor - الصَّبُورُ - The Patient One

The name As Saboor signifies Allah's enduring patience and ability to withhold anger and punishment, emphasizing His compassion and mercy towards humanity. The concept encourages believers to embody patience in their own lives, understanding the importance of forbearance in facing life's challenges.
verse:
Nuh - Noah - 71:2-3

Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning:

worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me.
